text: Michi o shiru mono wa katarazu, kataru mono wa michi o shirazu. Makoto no michi to wa me no mae no koto o tadashiku miwaki, tayumazu susumu koto de aru.
Wabi to sabi no kokoro wa, kagiri aru mono no naka ni eien no utsukushisa o miidasu fukai dousatsuryoku kara umareru. Ari no mama no sugata o aishi, mudana kazari o suteru.
Mono no aware to wa, utsuriyuku kisetsu ya hito no kokoro no hakanasa ni yorisoi, fukai doushu to kansha o komeru nihonjin koyuu no kansei de aru.
source: Motoori Norinaga, Genji Monogatari Tama no Ogushi

text: Kokoro o hitotsu ni shite mayowazu susumeba, donna kyoukou mo kirihiraku koto ga dekiru. Mizu no gotoku jiyuu ni katachi o kae, kesshite kokorozashi o ushinawazu ni are.
source: Miyamoto Musashi, Gorin no Sho (Mizu no Maki)

text: Kenkai o hiroge, yoku manabi, yoku kangaeru koto koso ga, fukanou o kanou ni kaeru yuiitsu no houteishiki de aru. Hibi no tsumikasane o kesshite anadoru koto nakare.
